summary: Short steep bush-edged kerb on a narrow lane with no room to pull off.
reasons: Trees to lane edge, no pull-off

drivers.seclusion: East side is bush, but a house sits 16 m away and the section is only 15 m long.
drivers.access_and_room: Narrow sealed lane with trees to the edge on the east and a fence line on the west; no clear ground to pull fully out of the lane.
drivers.traffic: Quiet lane; a busy road runs beyond the bush to the east.
drivers.convention: No parked cars or markings seen.

sun_shade: Dense tree canopy over the east side; shaded most of the day.
